rule: One coherent task per Codex thread. A milestone is not a single context window. Product tasks start unimplemented.

tasks.title: Bootstrap handoff and verify repository
tasks.scope: Inspect actual local root, GitHub origin, branch and working tree. Fetch without resetting. Compare BASELINE.json with current code. Preview the overlay outside the checkout, create a safe feature branch and install only nonconflicting handoff files. Reconcile existing AGENTS/status files rather than overwrite them. Do not fix downloader behavior in this task.
deliverables: Local and remote inventory in STATUS.md
Reconciled task register and baseline drift note
Handoff-only commit pushed to feature branch; one draft PR or documented remote blocker

tasks.title: Create efficient regression and CI foundations
tasks.scope: Introduce only the minimum import-safe seam needed for testing. Preserve all current observable behavior; keep active entry point and batch wrapper names. Create Pester unit and loopback integration runners, recorded development tool versions, and a small Windows 5.1/7 CI matrix. Demonstrate baseline defects without pretending skipped/pending regression cases pass. Use the synthetic fixture kit; never access the user archive.
deliverables: Baseline evidence and CI on feature branch; check pending coverage explicitly

tasks.title: Fix collections and safe Windows web requests
tasks.scope: Force episode-selection outputs to arrays and handle empty feeds and valid singleton cases. Centralize current web requests sufficiently to guarantee safe parsing in 5.1. Preserve the existing network engine for this small fix; do not redesign streaming/resume here.
deliverables: Regression tests for zero/one/many and modes
No legacy HTML parser prompt in Windows 5.1

tasks.title: Enforce safe deterministic Windows destinations
tasks.scope: Implement safe component naming, length budgeting, case-insensitive collision handling and canonical containment. Reject dot/dot-dot and metadata-controlled absolute paths. Address reparse-point risks conservatively. Do not rename or reorganize existing archives.
deliverables: Destination containment check at write boundary

tasks.title: Make file completion transactional
tasks.scope: Download to owned same-directory temporary files. Validate transfer outcome, nonempty body and obvious non-audio responses; distinguish HTTP body framing from publisher enclosure estimates. Close streams and finalize without overwriting existing media. Start with safe restart, not resume. Add crash/finalize race tests.

tasks.title: Add stable identities and durable local history
tasks.scope: Implement versioned per-show state with stable feed and episode identity, relative destinations, outcome and evidence fields. Serialize updates via an exclusive writer mechanism; avoid two writers corrupting JSON. Preserve exact request URLs separately from display strings. Scope feed aliases explicitly and reconcile completion/history crash gaps.
deliverables: Stable identity/collision behavior independent of mutable titles

tasks.title: Protect and migrate legacy archives
tasks.scope: Add a non-destructive legacy inventory/adoption plan. Never reclassify files as verified merely because they exist or match a historical filename. Default to unverified/conflict, record confidence and require explicit adoption/re-download policy. Do not delete/overwrite old media. Operate on copies/synthetic archives only.
deliverables: No-change hash evidence for all originals in tests

tasks.title: Make startup diagnostics private and reliable
tasks.scope: Create diagnostic plumbing before discovery, with safe fallback for unwritable destinations. Default to host-plus-opaque-ID URL display; do not try to prove arbitrary tokenized path segments safe through a short denylist. Sanitize verbose/error/export paths and exclude history/secrets from exports. Keep logging best effort and original exceptions intact. Integrate no-write preview behavior.
deliverables: UTF-8 unique run logs and startup fallback
Redaction helper and adversarial export tests

tasks.title: Enforce preview and untrusted-input boundaries
tasks.scope: Implement a plan-before-execute pipeline and explicit ShouldProcess checks for writes. Preview may fetch feeds but never media or persistent state. Validate all network targets; retain TLS and credential boundaries. Configure bounded XML parsing with DTD prohibited and external resolution disabled. Do not assert a proven exploit from the earlier static review.
deliverables: XML/response limits and no external entity fetch

tasks.title: Implement bounded retry and timeout policy
tasks.scope: Establish one transport abstraction compatible with both supported engines. Use streaming and cancellation where needed, with separate header/idle-transfer policy and finite budgets. Classify transient vs permanent failures. Respect server delay without retrying early when delay exceeds budget; report defer/failure instead. Inject clock/delay into unit tests.
deliverables: Transport adapter with configurable retry defaults
Loopback integration evidence for failure classes

tasks.title: Add validator-aware safe resume
tasks.scope: Add resume on top of the tested temporary-file/history engine, using owned sidecars and conservative validators. Verify identity, byte offset, representation and returned ranges before append. Restart safely for ignored Range or changed/weak/unknown validators. Handle 416 without assuming success. Keep resume policy isolated and covered by byte-for-byte tests.
deliverables: Resume sidecar schema and recovery rules

tasks.title: Unify feed discovery and resolution
tasks.scope: Use the same resolver for TUI and CLI. Classify actual XML roots, reuse fetched responses and handle empty feeds distinctly. Resolve relative discovery links using final response URI and supported base semantics; decode entities; return multiple candidates. Noninteractive ambiguity must follow a documented selection policy or explicit error.
deliverables: Shared resolver returning candidates and content
No extra discovery dependencies required at runtime

tasks.title: Normalize publication dates and stable ordering
tasks.scope: Use culture-independent date handling with DateTimeOffset or equivalent explicit offset semantics. Prefer Atom published over updated and read Atom id. Document filename date convention and missing/tied date ordering. Do not mutate existing paths merely because parsing improves.

tasks.title: Select and preserve supported audio formats
tasks.scope: Select supported audio deliberately among enclosure candidates. Combine metadata, headers and bounded sniffing rather than trust one signal. Handle extensionless URLs and at least existing MP3/M4A flows; document tested additional formats. Never re-encode. Keep signature checks modest and do not advertise complete media decoding or guaranteed integrity.
deliverables: Correct final extensions and generic content handling
Tests for conflicting metadata and HTML responses

tasks.title: Follow explicit feed pagination safely
tasks.scope: Implement bounded traversal only for supported explicitly advertised pagination/archive mechanisms. Deduplicate by identity, detect cycles and preserve page-fetch failures in the run outcome. Document Latest/Custom behavior when all pages cannot be proven date-ordered. Do not scrape providers or promise missing historical media.

tasks.title: Finalize CLI, results and launcher semantics
tasks.scope: Implement documented parameter combinations: CustomCount alone implies Custom; conflicting explicit mode fails. Introduce explicit noninteractive mode and consistent result objects/exit mapping at the script boundary only. Preserve double-click guided usage; pass launcher arguments safely and preserve result code; no pause for automation.
deliverables: 0 success / 1 fatal / 2 incomplete / 130 catchable cancellation contract
Updated batch launcher with safe paths/arguments

tasks.title: Polish cancellation, preflight and concurrent-run safety
tasks.scope: Complete user-facing behavior around existing writer protection: informative lock conflicts and safe stale-state recovery without killing arbitrary processes. Check destination write access and available space where estimates are reliable. Dispose handles on cancellation; preserve partials and report unknown-length estimates honestly.

tasks.title: Improve progress and optional temporary keep-awake
tasks.scope: Add meaningful progress for known/unknown length and quiet redirected output. Keep-awake must be an explicit optional Windows-only setting, disabled by default and restored during normal exception/cancellation cleanup. Do not change OS power policy or claim cleanup after an uncatchable hard kill.

tasks.title: Add opt-in saved shows and sequential batch mode
tasks.scope: Add small schema-versioned configuration and explicit named-show commands while leaving the current one-off workflow unchanged. Validate data as data, protect credential-bearing URLs locally, isolate show failures and provide aggregate results. Keep sequential bounded behavior; no daemon/account/player/scheduler expansion.
deliverables: Config validation and safe storage/export policy
Batch WhatIf and partial failure tests

tasks.title: Complete maintainability and compatibility audit
tasks.scope: Consolidate the architecture introduced in small steps; do not restart as a rewrite. Remove duplicated parsing/transport decisions and unneeded global preferences. Re-run lint and cross-engine matrix; document justified suppressions. Keep installed app package simple despite internal module organization.

tasks.title: Write verified help and user documentation
tasks.scope: Replace repetitive prose with accurate standard PowerShell help and tested README examples. Explain current behavior, actual formats/pagination scope, recovery/migration, privacy and security choices. Test literal copy/paste commands from a fresh extraction and include honest limitations.
deliverables: Compatibility table backed by actual versions

tasks.title: Build traceable release ZIPs and checksums
tasks.scope: Add a release packaging command that selects only runtime files, license and useful help. Include newly imported modules; record version and source commit; exclude tests/handoff/history/logs/media/config secrets. Produce SHA-256 checksums and a manifest. Reproducible inventory is mandatory; byte-for-byte reproducibility requires fixed archive metadata and may be separately documented.
deliverables: Local versioned release ZIP and manifest/checksums
Build command and package smoke tests

tasks.title: Prepare secure GitHub release workflow
tasks.scope: Audit actions and artifacts, pin reviewed action commits and development tooling, keep minimal permissions. Create/update draft release material only after package tests. Do not enable auto-publish, push release tags, change repository controls, buy signing credentials or claim a hash alone authenticates the publisher. Authenticode remains an explicitly gated optional distribution decision.
deliverables: Draft release notes and approval checklist
No unapproved publication or settings changes

tasks.title: Prepare website-ready distribution content
tasks.scope: Prepare portable product-page Markdown, a version metadata example and a real local TUI screenshot when available. Clearly separate planned from released features. No domain/site repository has been selected for this tool website, so do not create a framework/site deployment or touch Anti-Commercial or another project. Keep content ready for later integration.
deliverables: Screenshot capture instructions or real captured asset

tasks.title: Run release-candidate acceptance from a clean clone
tasks.scope: Use the active Windows development machine for authoritative checks. Build from clean committed source, extract outside repo, exercise both engine workflows and copied/synthetic legacy archives. Reconcile every acceptance case with evidence and actual artifact version. Supplement with optional small user-authorized live-feed smoke, never private subscription or overnight full catalogue by default.
deliverables: Completed acceptance evidence matrix with failed/unrun cases explicit
Release readiness report, not automatic approval

tasks.title: Owner-review handoff and publication gate
tasks.scope: Prepare final local/remote synchronization report and owner review package. Stop before merge/tag/public release/site deployment unless separately authorized for the exact action. Record approved publication actions only after completion and verify resulting remote artifacts. Optional signing and live website integration can remain owner-gated without being falsely marked implemented.
deliverables: Final continuation prompt or scoped publication outcome
